name: Olduvai Lobus
origin: Olduvai Gorge (Tanzania), a major paleoanthropological site.

name: Afar Lobus
origin: Afar Triangle (Ethiopia), site of many important fossil finds.

name: Hadar Regio
origin: Hadar (Ethiopia), the paleontological fossil site within the Afar Triangle where the Lucy fossil was discovered in 1974.

name: Luzia Dorsum
origin: Luzia Woman, a 11,500 year-old female skeleton found at Lapa Vermelha in Brazil; named as an homage to the Lucy fossil.

name: Minatogawa Regio
origin: Minatogawa limestone quarry (Okinawa, Japan) where four skeletons of early Homo sapiens (20,000-22,000 BCE) were excavated in 1968, 1970, and 1974.

name: Cashel Saxum
origin: Cashel, town in County Laois, Ireland, near which the preserved body of a young adult male, Cashel Man, was found in a bog; one of the oldest known “bog bodies” in Europe and dates to ~2000 BCE.

name: Kennewick Saxum
origin: Kennewick, city in Washington state, USA, near which Kennewick Man, a 9,300 BP human male skeleton discovered in 1996.

name: Boxgrove Saxum
origin: Boxgrove, village in England and site of discovery of Homo heidelbergensis fossils and direct evidence of hunting and butchering by early humans.

name: Mungo
origin: Lake Mungo (New South Wales, Australia) is the site of three significant finds of human including Mungo woman, one of the earliest known cremations.

name: Narmada
origin: Narmada River Valley (India), site of Narmada Human, fossil remains of an indeterminate hominin species, the oldest found in India (50,000 – 150,000 BCE).

name: Windover Collum
origin: Windover Pond, a site in Florida, USA, yielding remains of 168 individuals (including soft tissue) dating from ~7300 years BP.
